caption:
Most Canadian students already use AI for schoolwork. Fewer than half of educators think students are getting enough guidance on using it responsibly.

That gap between adoption and instruction is the real policy problem, not the technology.

Three things schools can do this term 👇 and if you lead a school or a parent council, this is exactly what our PD sessions and parent nights cover. Link in bio.

Source: KPMG Canada survey of students and educators.
